privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: MeetMatee ("we", "us", "our") collects and uses personal information to operate the platform, generate AI meeting services, enhance user experience, and fulfil service requests. We comply with applicable privacy laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles and GDPR where relevant.

sections.title: Data We Collect
items: Identity & Contact Information: Name, email address, organisation (when provided).
Content Inputs: Configuration parameters, prompt inputs, business profile info, email addresses, and other content required to configure meeting profiles.
Usage Data: IP address, device/browser details, session logs, call transcript files, activity data, and interaction history within the product.
Cookies & Tracking Technologies: Used for analytics, authentication, and improving performance. See our Cookie Policy for details.

sections.title: Purpose of Processing
items: Provide, operate, and improve the MeetMatee meeting-generation and assistant service
Authenticate and manage user accounts
Process meeting configuration and version requests
Respond to support enquiries
Personalise content, recommendations, and communication
Monitor security, detect fraud, and prevent misuse
Analyse usage to enhance product performance

sections.title: Legal Basis (GDPR – where applicable)
sections.description: For users in the EU/UK/EEA, our processing is based on:
items: Consent: analytics, marketing, optional cookies
Performance of a Contract: providing voice agent configurations and account services
Legitimate Interests: service improvement, security, troubleshooting—balanced with user rights

sections.title: Sharing & Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data.
items: Service Providers: telephony servers, database hosting, cloud hosting, analytics, billing integrations (Stripe), email dispatchers  strictly under contractual obligations
Legal Authorities: where required by law
Business Transfers: if MeetMatee undergoes a merger, acquisition, or similar event (with prior notice where required)

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.description: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to:
items: Provide services
Meet legal obligations
Resolve disputes
Maintain secure backups
sections.footerNote: Users may request deletion at any time.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.description: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may:
items: Access, correct, or delete your information
Restrict or object to certain processing
Withdraw consent for optional processing (e.g., marketing)
Request a portable copy of your data
Lodge a complaint with a data protection authority (for GDPR regions)

sections.title: International Transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be stored or processed in countries outside your own.
Where GDPR applies, we use appropriate safeguards such as:
items: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
Equivalent protective measures

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Material changes will be posted here with an updated date.

sections.title: Acceptance
paragraphs: Using MeetMatee ("the Service") constitutes your agreement to these Terms of Service.
If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.title: Service Description
paragraphs: MeetMatee provides an AI-powered platform that creates custom meeting assistants based on the parameters, configuration scripts, and templates you provide.
Features, availability, pricing, and functionality may change at any time.

sections.title: Accounts & Responsibilities
items: Maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials
All actions taken under your account
Providing accurate, up-to-date information
sections.footerNote: We may suspend accounts that contain misleading information or violate these Terms.

paragraphs: You retain full ownership of the content and scripts you upload or generate through the Service.

By using MeetMatee, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, host, process, reproduce, and display content solely for the purpose of operating, improving, and providing the Service.
items: You have the rights to upload any configuration content you provide
Your content does not violate intellectual property rights, privacy rights, or any applicable laws

sections.title: Acceptable Use Guidelines
sections.description: You agree not to upload or generate content that is:
items: Illegal or infringing
Defamatory, hateful, abusive, or harassing
Pornographic or sexually explicit
Violent, harmful, or malicious
Misleading, fraudulent, or used for impersonation
Designed to exploit, harm, or deceive others
sections.footerNote: We may remove content and suspend or terminate accounts for violations of these rules.

sections.title: Fees & Payment Terms
items: Fees are listed at the time of purchase
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled
You may cancel your subscription at any time
Refunds follow our published billing guidelines
sections.footerNote: We may change pricing with reasonable notice.

calloutBox.title: Disclaimer
calloutBox.description: MeetMatee is provided "as is" and "as available." We do not guarantee uninterrupted service, accuracy of results, or suitability for any specific purpose. No warranties are provided beyond those required by law.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
items: We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages
We are not responsible for loss of revenue, profits, data, reputation, or business opportunities
Our total liability is limited to the amount paid by you in the last 3 months (if any)

sections.title: Termination & Cancellation
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these Terms, your account is inactive for an extended period, or required by law.
You may cancel your account via your dashboard or billing portal.

contactBox.description: For questions regarding these Terms, please contact us at:

sections.title: What Are Cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small data files stored on your device to recognise you, remember preferences, and enhance your experience on MeetMatee.

gridCards.title: Essential Cookies
gridCards.description: Required for the platform to function (login, authentication, session stability).

gridCards.title: Performance & Analytics Cookies
gridCards.description: Help us understand how users interact with MeetMatee, identify errors, and improve speed and performance.

gridCards.title: Functional Cookies
gridCards.description: Remember your preferences (language, settings, saved choices) to provide a smoother experience.

gridCards.title: Marketing Cookies
gridCards.description: Optional third-party cookies used to personalise communication, track conversions, and show relevant content.

sections.title: Consent
paragraphs: On your first visit, we request your consent for any non-essential cookies. You can adjust or withdraw your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie settings panel.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
paragraphs: Some cookies may be placed by trusted third-party providers for analytics, embedded services, or marketing. Their usage is governed by their respective privacy and cookie policies.

calloutBox.title: 💡 Managing Cookies
calloutBox.description: You may disable or delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note: disabling essential cookies may limit certain features or prevent parts of MeetMatee from working properly.

sections.title: Updates to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in cookie usage or legal requirements. The latest revision date will always be shown at the top of this page.
